correctness.rationale: With k algebraically closed of characteristic 3, m≥5 and m≡2(mod 3), λ≠0, the AS rational function λ/(x^m−1) has m distinct simple poles and is not h³−h. Riemann–Hurwitz yields g=2m−2 and Deuring–Shafarevich p-rank 2m−2. Any other rational subfield of index 3 would either equal k(x), by prime-degree compositum, or form with k(x) a birational (3,3) curve on P¹×P¹ of normalization genus at most 4, contradicting g≥8. Thus all geometric automorphisms descend to PGL2 stabilizers of μ_m, kernel exactly C3. The binary form U^m−V^m has nonzero characteristic-3 Hessian −m²(m−1)² U^{m−2}V^{m−2}; a branch-set stabilizer preserves {0,∞}, hence acts by x↦ax or a/x with a^m=1, at most 2m choices. Lifts R:x↦ζx, T:y↦y+1 and S:(x,y)↦(1/x,−y+c), c³−c=−λ, realize C_{3m}⋊C2 of size6m and meet the upper bound. Independent exact rational-function and Hessian checks at m=5,8,11,14 agree; the all-m proof does not infer unbounded rigidity from finite data.
